newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News' Cowley disappointed with 97/8 budget.
newsitem.headline: News' Cowley disappointed with 97/8 budget.

text.p: The chairman of News Corp Ltd's Australian offshoot News Ltd, Ken Cowley, said on Wednesday he was disappointed with the 1997/98 federal budget and called on the Howard government to introduce bolder economic strategies.

"The country deserves some boldness and some major structural changes," Cowley told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio. Cowley, who steps down at the end of June to be replaced at the local helm by News Corp chairman and founder Rupert Murdoch's son Lachlan, said the budget was "safe and careful".

"It was not as dynamic and bold as it could be," said Cowley, who also expressed concern at the government's lack response to the decision by Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd to close its Newcastle steelmaking operations.
